profile.name: Aravind Russell V
profile.title: Test Automation Architect
profile.headline: I architect test automation frameworks and quality gates for enterprise platforms.
profile.about: Test Automation Architect with 12 years of experience in Software Quality Engineering across Client/Server and Web applications, including lead and architect responsibilities for test strategy, frameworks and quality gates on enterprise platforms; proficient in Java, Python, TypeScript & JavaScript.
highlights: Architected scalable, reusable and modular automation frameworks from scratch using Playwright, Selenium WebDriver, Cucumber (BDD), TestNG, JUnit and PyTest, applying Page Object Model and Data-Driven, Keyword-Driven and Hybrid design patterns.

Implemented the Playwright framework from scratch and integrated MCP (Model Context Protocol); built a RAG pipeline for requirement analysis. Post Graduate Diploma in Artificial Intelligence (IIIT Delhi).
Embedded automated suites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins) with Maven and Git/GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket for continuous testing and nightly execution.
Hands-on API automation using Java (Rest Assured) and Python for RESTful services, with SQL (MSSQL) back-end validation; experienced in Agile, Scrum and Waterfall SDLC.

Established quality gates and testing standards across development teams; reviewed test code using Code Collaborator; expert in test planning, estimation, Requirement Traceability Matrix (RTM) and Smoke, Functional, Regression, Integration, UAT and Cross-Browser testing.

stats.label: AI-assisted testing with Claude Code & GitHub Copilot

Led test environment planning, setup and management for complex systems.
Hands-on with Selenium WebDriver, JUnit, Cucumber, Rest Assured and database testing; developed hybrid frameworks combining data-driven, keyword-driven and BDD approaches.
Implemented API testing solutions for RESTful web services with SQL back-end validation.
